<thought>Based on the observed isotopic distribution (M+1 ≈ 6.7 % and M+2 ≈ 0.6 % of the base peak), the pattern matches the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing roughly six carbons. No other element shows its characteristic isotopic spacing or relative intensities (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from this spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
